name: Thunder Arena
direction: A wide pixel-art arena with the balances built into its monumental architecture.
detail: An exuberant colourful PIXEL-ART SCENE, inspired by classic 16-bit arcade stages, visually very different from a close-up comic portrait. A wide mythic arena of cobalt Greek/Asgardian columns, a huge golden sun, floating white clouds, cream stone floor with red geometric mosaic. Small but clearly recognizable adult Thor on the left in complete silver armour, winged helmet and red cape; adult Wonder Woman on the right in complete high-neck gold-and-blue armour and red cape. Both are standing proudly on opposite sides, with relaxed arms, not fighting. The large architecture is the focal point: TWO ENORMOUS CREAM STONE TABLETS suspended between columns across the upper middle bear CLAUDE 20% WEEK LEFT and CODEX 95% WEEK LEFT. The heroes' figures anchor the lower quarter. Rich hand-crafted pixel clusters, large clean silhouettes, dramatic open sky and plenty of breathing room. Numbers are part of the stage, not an overlay toolbar.
prompt:
Create one finished landscape 4:3 fan-art mockup for a small e-ink usage display. Original comic interpretations of the named adult characters, not actors or photographs. All characters wear the fully covering outfits described. Playful or noble friendly rivalry, no injury or sexualized posing. Flat black, cream, red, yellow, cobalt and green graphic inks, strong silhouettes and broad light regions; crisp readable lettering at small sizes.
Exact required text, highly legible and prominent: "CLAUDE", "20%", "WEEK LEFT" on the Marvel side; "CODEX", "95%", "WEEK LEFT" on the DC side. Both mean weekly allowance remaining. Optional small reset captions "FRI 18:00" with Claude and "WED 14:49" with Codex. Do not add any other numbers, gauges, publisher logos or watermarks. Full-screen art only, no physical device or surrounding mockup.

name: Comic Pinball
direction: A comic pinball playfield where the balances become giant scoring targets.
detail: A bold playful top-down PINBALL PLAYFIELD ILLUSTRATION starring adult Deadpool and adult Harley Quinn, not a photograph or physical arcade machine. Deadpool in complete red-black suit and mask is a large expressive illustrated portrait at upper left; Harley in her complete classic red-black jester suit and headpiece is a mischievous illustrated portrait at lower right. Both are fully clothed and friendly. Sweeping yellow rails, cobalt ramps, red stars, big cream bumpers and graphic ink motion lines connect the whole artwork. Two GIANT CREAM SCORING TARGETS dominate the centre-left and centre-right, integrated into the curves of the playfield: CLAUDE / 20% / WEEK LEFT and CODEX / 95% / WEEK LEFT. Rectangular or oval target interiors are spacious and unobstructed. There are NO other scoring numerals, bonus counts or tiny labels. Style: clean 1960s POP ART with thick black outlines, big flat colours, restrained Ben-Day dots, loads of cream negative space. Smaller star-shaped decorative bumpers frame the data. Make this a distinctive collectible poster, not a dashboard.

name: Tide & Tempest
direction: Two elegant comic-cover panels, arranged as a matching diptych.
detail: A sophisticated ART-DECO COMIC COVER DIPTYCH, with two adjacent tall illustrated panels within one landscape image. Left panel: adult Storm with dark skin and flowing white hair wears a complete high-neck white-and-gold jumpsuit and a sweeping cape, standing in a dramatic wind over angular cobalt mountains; a white cloud radiates clean geometric sunbeams. Right panel: adult Aquaman wears complete orange scale armour and green gloves, standing amid a stylized curling wave and an ornate underwater city. Both are dignified, fully clothed, nonviolent. Show figures at three-quarter length with graceful poses and elegant long contours, not close-up faces. Each panel has an enormous CREAM ART-DECO TITLE CARTOUCHE integrated along its lower third. Left exact text CLAUDE / 20% / WEEK LEFT. Right CODEX / 95% / WEEK LEFT. The numerals are colossal black geometric lettering. Background is mostly ivory paper, with black, cobalt, green, yellow and red-orange accents. Thin ornamental gold borders, rich but spacious shapes, no extra cover headlines, issue numbers or prices. The composition should feel like a beautiful matched pair of vintage art prints.
